rules.title: Annual General Adjustment capped at 5% (Measure BB)
rules.requirement: Landlords of fully covered units may raise rent each year only by the Annual General Adjustment set by the Rent Board using a CPI-based formula. Measure BB caps the AGA at 5%, though banked unused AGAs from prior years may still be applied to reach the rent ceiling.
rules.coverage_conditions: Fully covered units, chiefly most units in multifamily properties built before 1980, single-family homes with tenancies that began before 1996, and single-family homes with five or more individually rented rooms. Fully covered government-owned or subsidized units now also have a rent ceiling.
rules.exemptions: Partially covered units (new construction with a certificate of occupancy issued after 1980, most single-family homes, most condominiums) have no rent ceiling. Shared kitchen/bath units are exempt only if the landlord lived on the property at the start of the tenancy. Banked AGAs may exceed 5% to reach the rent ceiling.

coverage.unverifiable_conditions: Single-family homes are fully covered only if the tenancy began before 1996 or five or more rooms are rented individually. Shared kitchen/bath exemption depends on landlord residence. Subsidized-unit coverage depends on the subsidy type and HUD mortgage status.

rules.citation: Berkeley Rent Ordinance, as amended by Measure BB (Nov. 2024)
rules.quoted_span: The maximum AGA is 5%. This means that, if the formula in the Rent Ordinance results in an AGA that is greater than 5%, the AGA approved by the Board for that year can be no more than 5%.
rules.conflict_note: Page does not state Measure BB's effective date or a municipal code section. The 1980 cutoff is described both as 'built before 1980' (fully covered) and as 'certificate of occupancy issued after 1980' (new construction, partially covered), so treatment of 1980 itself is ambiguous.

rules.title: Government-owned or subsidized units now covered by Rent Ordinance
rules.requirement: Government-owned or subsidized units (e.g., Section 8, Shelter Plus Care, VASH, LIHTC, HOME) must be registered as fully or partially covered and pay an annual registration fee. Fully covered subsidized units have a rent ceiling limited by the AGA.
rules.coverage_conditions: Government-owned or subsidized units. Whether a unit is fully or partially covered depends on unit type and any federal or state preemption.
rules.exemptions: The following are partially covered (no rent ceiling) regardless of unit type: Section 202 and Section 811 units, and Rent Supplement, Section 8 Loan Management Set Aside, and Project-based Section 8 units in projects with HUD-insured or HUD-held mortgages.

coverage.unverifiable_conditions: Depends on the subsidy type and whether the project has a HUD-insured or HUD-held mortgage.

rules.citation: Berkeley Rent Ordinance, as amended by Measure BB (Nov. 2024)
rules.quoted_span: Government-owned or -subsidized rental units become either fully or partially covered by the Rent Ordinance.
rules.conflict_note: Effective date not stated on page.

rules.title: Rent increase petitions only for completed capital improvements
rules.requirement: Landlords may petition for rent increases only for completed capital improvements. They can no longer obtain preliminary authorization for planned improvements.
rules.coverage_conditions: Fully covered units subject to the rent ceiling.
rules.citation: Berkeley Rent Ordinance, as amended by Measure BB (Nov. 2024)
rules.quoted_span: Landlords can only file a petition for rent increases for completed capital improvements (they can no longer petition to have rent increases preliminarily authorized for planned capital improvements).
rules.conflict_note: Effective date not stated on page.

rules.title: Utility charges must be in base rent unless separately metered
rules.requirement: For tenancies starting on or after February 6, 2024 in fully covered units, landlords may charge for utilities only as part of base rent, or where the utility is separately metered and in the tenant's name under the lease. Adding utility costs to the rent ceiling requires a Rent Board petition.
rules.coverage_conditions: Fully covered units; tenancies starting on or after February 6, 2024.
rules.exemptions: Separately metered utilities placed in the tenant's name as required by the lease.

coverage.unverifiable_conditions: Tenancy start date on or after 2024-02-06; utility metering arrangement.

rules.citation: Berkeley Rent Ordinance, as amended by Measure BB (Nov. 2024)
rules.quoted_span: Utility charges must be a set amount incorporated into the base rent at the start of a tenancy unless the utility is separately metered and the account is in the tenant’s name as specified in the lease.
rules.conflict_note: The February 6, 2024 applicability date predates the November 2024 election that passed Measure BB; this may be retroactive application or a typo. Categorized under rent limits because it governs charges beyond the rent ceiling.

rules.title: Just cause required for evictions from fully or partially covered units
rules.requirement: Tenants in units fully or partially covered by the Rent Ordinance cannot be evicted without just cause (formerly called good cause).
rules.coverage_conditions: Fully and partially covered units, including new construction, most single-family homes and condos, and government-subsidized units.
rules.exemptions: Exempt units, including units where the tenant shares kitchen or bath with a landlord who lived on the property at the start of the tenancy.

coverage.unverifiable_conditions: Shared kitchen/bath exemption depends on the landlord residing on the property before the tenancy began.

rules.citation: Berkeley Rent Ordinance (Rent Stabilization and Eviction for Good Cause)
rules.quoted_span: In Berkeley, tenants in units that are fully or partially covered by the Rent Ordinance cannot be evicted unless there is "just cause” (previously called “good cause”).
rules.conflict_note: Page does not give a code citation or the original enactment date.

rules.title: No nonpayment eviction for debt under one month's Fair Market Rent
rules.requirement: A landlord may evict for nonpayment only if the tenant owes rental debt at least equal to one month of HUD Fair Market Rent for an equivalent-size unit in the Oakland-Fremont HUD Metro FMR area for the fiscal year in which rent is demanded.
rules.citation: Berkeley Rent Ordinance, as amended by Measure BB (Nov. 2024)
rules.quoted_span: Eviction for nonpayment of rent is no longer permitted for rental debt of less than one month’s Fair Market Rent for a unit of equivalent size.
rules.conflict_note: Effective date not stated on page.

rules.title: No eviction for failing to sign a substantially similar lease
rules.requirement: A landlord cannot evict a tenant for refusing to sign a substantially similar lease when a fixed-term lease expires. Measure BB eliminated this just cause.
rules.citation: Berkeley Rent Ordinance, as amended by Measure BB (Nov. 2024)
rules.quoted_span: A landlord cannot evict a tenant for failing to sign a substantially similar lease upon expiration of a fixed-term lease.
rules.conflict_note: Effective date not stated on page.

rules.title: Stricter requirements for lease-violation evictions
rules.requirement: Lease-breach evictions require a mutually agreed material term, substantial actual damage to the landlord, and proof that the tenant's behavior was unreasonable. The prior notice to cease must specify the lease term and describe the violation and resulting harm.
rules.citation: Berkeley Rent Ordinance, as amended by Measure BB (Nov. 2024)
rules.quoted_span: In any notice terminating a tenancy for a lease breach, the landlord must clearly describe the alleged breach. The landlord must demonstrate that the tenant’s behavior was unreasonable, and may not evict tenants for lease breaches that do not cause the landlord any actual harm.
rules.conflict_note: Effective date not stated on page.

rules.title: Eviction notice content and three-business-day filing with Rent Board
rules.requirement: Termination notices must state that advice is available from the Rent Board and include its counseling phone number and website. Copies of termination notices, notices to quit, and summons and complaints must be filed with the Rent Board within three business days of service.
rules.citation: Berkeley Rent Ordinance, as amended by Measure BB (Nov. 2024)
rules.quoted_span: The landlord must file with the Rent Board a copy of any notice to terminate a tenancy, notice to quit, and summons and complaint no later than three business days after the tenant was served with the document.
rules.conflict_note: Effective date not stated on page.

rules.title: Mandatory annual inflation adjustment of owner move-in relocation payments
rules.requirement: The Rent Board must adjust owner move-in eviction relocation assistance amounts for inflation each year.
rules.coverage_conditions: Owner move-in evictions from covered units.
rules.citation: Berkeley Rent Ordinance, as amended by Measure BB (Nov. 2024)
rules.quoted_span: The Rent Board must make inflationary adjustments to owner move-in eviction relocation assistance amounts each year.
rules.conflict_note: Effective date and payment amounts not stated on page.
